title: Local free generator of a module sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U\subseteq X$ open, and $e\in\Gamma(U,M)$. The section $e$ is a free generator on $U$ if for every open $V\subseteq U$, the map $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(V,M)$, $r\mapsto r e|_V$, is bijective. Equivalently, multiplication by $e$ gives a trivialization $\mathcal O_U\cong M|_U$.
